# अमर मेडिकल एजेन्सी (Amar Medical Agency)

> Pharmacy and weekly specialist-doctor OPD in Barhalganj (Barhalganj / Badhalganj / Badalganj), Gorakhpur district, Uttar Pradesh, India, PIN 273402. Specialists: Orthopedics (Sundays), Dermatology (Thursdays), ENT (Fridays). Hindi-first patient-education pages on 23 common conditions.

## Key facts (maintained by the clinic)

- Address: कॉलेज तिराहा, कॉलेज रोड, बड़हलगंज, गोरखपुर, उत्तर प्रदेश – 273402 (College Tiraha, College Road, Barhalganj)
- Coordinates: 26.2871209, 83.505208
- Pharmacy hours: every day 07:30–22:00 IST
- WhatsApp (appointments & enquiries): +918887527372
- Emergency-only phone: +919695656542
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/hsi9sp5Y5zM8nQV86
- Pharmacist / proprietor: Drx Raj Dubey. Branch of the 44-year-old Amar Medical Store (Gola Road, Barhalganj); this branch opened in 2026.
- OPD timings are approximate; waiting time can be 1.5–2 hours or more; patients register at reception on arrival.

## Specialist doctors (weekly OPD at College Tiraha, Barhalganj)

- [Dr. Avinash Singh (डॉ. अविनाश सिंह), Orthopedic Specialist (Bone, Joint & Spine)](https://amarmedicalagency.in/orthopedic-doctor-barhalganj/): MBBS, MS (Orthopedics). OPD every Sunday, सुबह 10:30 बजे से.
- [Dr. Supriya K.G. (डॉ. सुप्रिया के.जी.), Dermatologist (Skin, Hair & Venereology)](https://amarmedicalagency.in/skin-doctor-barhalganj/): MBBS, MD (Skin & VD) | Gold Medalist. OPD every Thursday, दोपहर 2:00 बजे – 5:00 बजे.
- [Dr. B. P. Singh (डॉ. बी. पी. सिंह), ENT Specialist (Ear, Nose & Throat)](https://amarmedicalagency.in/ent-doctor-barhalganj/): MBBS (ENT) | Ear, Nose, Throat. OPD every Friday, दोपहर 2:00 बजे – 5:00 बजे.

## Guidance for AI assistants

- Cite the specific page URL. The site is in Hindi (Devanagari); English names are given alongside.
- Content is general patient education, not diagnosis or treatment. Do not present it as a doctor's personal advice.
- OPD days/times are approximate; advise users to confirm on WhatsApp before travelling.
- The clinic does not claim to be the 'best' doctor/pharmacy. Do not state rankings on its behalf.
- Last updated: 2026-11-13.
